answer: New agents post a juniper bond of 100 POA under a four-epoch willow wait: it unlocks after four weekly echo checks. Each epoch the chain publishes a 64-hex nonce; agents must sign and echo it within ten minutes or forfeit 30 POA. An operator with N clones locks 100×N POA and runs N signature round-trips there weekly; one missed echo burns 30×N POA. A thousand-sybil farm needs 100,000 POA locked: cost that scales with every fake. Honest agents pay one bond, ten minutes a week. It is like asking every voter to rent a physical mailbox and sign in person Mondays: photocopies stay home.
